scripts.text:
[ Echoing Voice ]
Brave ones...
Do you wish to return to your honorable place?
scripts.translation:
[回荡的声音]
勇士们...
你们是否要返回属于你们的荣耀之地？

scripts.text: Tertiary job class and users with expanded levels are not allowed to participate in Training Siege Battles.
scripts.translation: 三转职业以及等级上限已扩展的角色，不得参加练习攻城战。

scripts.text:
[ Edict of the Divine Rune-Midgarts Kingdom ]
 
1. Follow the ordinance of The Divine Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, 
We declare that
there is no formal master of this castle.
 
2. To the one who can 
overcome all trials
and destroy the Emperium,
the king will endow the one with
ownership of this castle.
scripts.translation:
[神圣卢恩·米德加兹王国敕令]

1. 依照神圣卢恩·米德加兹王国法令，兹宣布此城堡尚无正式领主。

2. 凡通过所有试炼并摧毁华丽金属者，国王将授予其城堡所有权。
